query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.role, u.createdAt
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON s.userId = u.id
WHERE s.id IS NULL AND u.role != 'admin'
ORDER BY u.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
